entries.title: Genesis 18:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD appeared to him by the terebinth trees of Mamre, as he was sitting in the tent door in the heat of the day.

entries.title: Genesis 18:2
segments: So he lifted his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing by him; and when he saw [them], he ran from the tent door to meet them, and bowed himself to the ground,

entries.title: Genesis 18:3
segments: and said, "My Lord, if I have now found favor in Your sight, do not pass on by Your servant.

entries.title: Genesis 18:4
segments: "Please let a little water be brought, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

entries.title: Genesis 18:5
segments: "And I will bring a morsel of bread, that you may refresh your hearts. After that you may pass by, inasmuch as you have come to your servant." They said, "Do as you have said."

entries.title: Genesis 18:6
segments: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said, "Quickly, make ready three measures of fine meal; knead [it] and make cakes."

entries.title: Genesis 18:7
segments: And Abraham ran to the herd, took a tender and good calf, gave [it] to a young man, and he hastened to prepare it.

entries.title: Genesis 18:8
segments: So he took butter and milk and the calf which he had prepared, and set [it] before them; and he stood by them under the tree as they ate.

entries.title: Genesis 18:9
segments: ¶Then they said to him, "Where [is] Sarah your wife?" So he said, "Here, in the tent."

entries.title: Genesis 18:10
segments: And He said, "I will certainly return to you according to the time of life, and behold, Sarah your wife shall have a son." (Sarah was listening in the tent door which [was] behind him.)

entries.title: Genesis 18:11
segments: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age; [and] Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

entries.title: Genesis 18:12
segments: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, "After I have grown old, shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?"

entries.title: Genesis 18:13
segments: And the LORD said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh, saying, 'Shall I surely bear [a child], since I am old?'

entries.title: Genesis 18:14
segments: "Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son."

entries.title: Genesis 18:15
segments: But Sarah denied [it], saying, "I did not laugh," for she was afraid. And He said, "No, but you did laugh!"

entries.title: Genesis 18:16
segments: ¶Then the men rose from there and looked toward Sodom, and Abraham went with them to send them on the way.

entries.title: Genesis 18:17
segments: And the LORD said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing,

entries.title: Genesis 18:18
segments: "since Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

entries.title: Genesis 18:19
segments: "For I have known him, in order that he may command his children and his household after him, that they keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice, that the LORD may bring to Abraham what He has spoken to him."

entries.title: Genesis 18:20
segments: And the LORD said, "Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grave,

entries.title: Genesis 18:21
segments: "I will go down now and see whether they have done altogether according to the outcry against it that has come to Me; and if not, I will know."

entries.title: Genesis 18:22
segments: Then the men turned away from there and went toward Sodom, but Abraham still stood before the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 18:23
segments: ¶And Abraham came near and said, "Would You also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

entries.title: Genesis 18:24
segments: "Suppose there were fifty righteous within the city; would You also destroy the place and not spare [it] for the fifty righteous that were in it?

entries.title: Genesis 18:25
segments: "Far be it from You to do such a thing as this, to slay the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be as the wicked; far be it from You! Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?"

entries.title: Genesis 18:26
segments: So the LORD said, "If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes."

entries.title: Genesis 18:27
segments: Then Abraham answered and said, "Indeed now, I who [am but] dust and ashes have taken it upon myself to speak to the Lord:

entries.title: Genesis 18:28
segments: "Suppose there were five less than the fifty righteous; would You destroy all of the city for [lack of] five?" So He said, "If I find there forty-five, I will not destroy [it]."

entries.title: Genesis 18:29
segments: And he spoke to Him yet again and said, "Suppose there should be forty found there?" So He said, "I will not do [it] for the sake of forty."

entries.title: Genesis 18:30
segments: Then he said, "Let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Suppose thirty should be found there?" So He said, "I will not do [it] if I find thirty there."

entries.title: Genesis 18:31
segments: And he said, "Indeed now, I have taken it upon myself to speak to the Lord: Suppose twenty should be found there?" So He said, "I will not destroy [it] for the sake of twenty."

entries.title: Genesis 18:32
segments: Then he said, "Let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak but once more: Suppose ten should be found there?" And He said, "I will not destroy [it] for the sake of ten."

entries.title: Genesis 18:33
segments: So the LORD went His way as soon as He had finished speaking with Abraham; and Abraham returned to his place.
